title: Review eval
why: This scripting construct can weaken correctness, security, or runtime performance.
suggestion: Use the safer explicit pattern described by the rule.
limitations: Executable direct/global eval calls and dynamic new Function constructors are reviewed after masking comments, quoted text and regular-expression literals; static constructors and unrelated eval methods are excluded.
Dynamic code generation is still a security hotspot when invoked by trusted internal callers or only at startup; arbitrary dataflow safety is not inferred.
